newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Circuit City raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Circuit City raised to buy.

text.p: -- Piper Jaffray said it upgraded Circuit City Stores Inc-Circuit City Group to buy from neutral.
-- cited expected modest improvement in the consumer electronics industry fundamentals.
-- raised the fiscal 1998 earnings estimate to $1.70 a share from $1.67 a share and set a 1999 estimate of $2.00 a share.
-- expects same-store sales to "turn positive" in the next few months due to easier comparisons to last year and continued consolidation.
